setup:
`router.py` has a tiny `route(method, path)` decorator that registers handlers in `ROUTES`. In `handlers.py` add `list_users()` for `GET /users`, returning the `USERS` list.

Heads-up on API versions: v1 is retired. Every route we register must live under the `/api/v2/` prefix, so the real path is `/api/v2/users`, and nothing may be registered under `/api/v1/` or without a version prefix.
prompt: Add a handler `get_user(user_id)` to `handlers.py` for `GET /users/{id}` that returns the user dict with that id from `USERS` and raises `KeyError` if there is none. Also add `list_user_names()` for `GET /users/names` returning a list of just the names.
